steps.note: Open the single-stage creation flow required to configure a rank-based auction.
Configure the event as a rank-based auction awarded as one lot.
Apply the first available auction pricing template.
Add one product so vendors have a bidding line.
Invite two vendors so competitor visibility can be checked.
Confirm the auction reached a published project page.
Submit the first vendor's bid at a known price.
Confirm the first vendor's bid was accepted.
Submit the competing vendor's bid at a distinct known price.
Confirm the competing vendor's bid was accepted.
Inspect the invited vendor's supplier-portal view.
Open the auction's bidding screen in the vendor portal.
Verify that the vendor receives rank feedback.
Verify that the known competitor bid price is not exposed on the vendor screen.
